Strings.database.mysql_remote_scope: Allows one exact IPv4 source. Opening and closing restart MySQL. Close access before account maintenance or administrator recovery.
Strings.database.mysql_maintenance_scope: Close remote access before maintenance. Backups stop MySQL and are verified in a private instance. Repair requires a verified backup and a stopped instance.
Strings.database.mysql_maintenance_compensated: Verification failed. MySQL resumed on its original packages and data.
Strings.database.mysql_delete_scope: Type the instance ID to uninstall and permanently delete its data, backups, and saved credentials.
Strings.database.mysql_remote_confirm: Change MySQL remote access? Existing sessions disconnect. Only the instance firewall rules are changed.
Strings.database.mysql_admin_recovery_confirm: Restore operating-system authentication for root@localhost? MySQL will stop. Ordinary startup is blocked during recovery and the instance remains stopped afterward.
Strings.database.mysql_accounts_scope: Accounts use localhost over the private Unix socket and have grants on one database. Update application credentials after rotation.
Strings.database.mysql_account_invalid: Check the database, user and password. Names use lowercase letters and digits. Passwords need 16–128 visible ASCII characters without quotes or backslashes.
Strings.database.mysql_scope: Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 · Single instance · Local connection verified over a private Unix socket.
Strings.database.mysql_confirm: Run this MySQL operation? First installation uses fixed Oracle core packages and signed Ubuntu dependencies.
Strings.database.delete_instance_confirm: Permanently delete data, credentials and backups for {0}. The primary instance keeps running and shared packages are retained.
Strings.database.port_conflict: The port is in use or reserved by another PostgreSQL cluster.
Strings.database.initialize_hint: Create an isolated data directory with checksums, local peer administration and loopback-only SCRAM access. Choose an unused port.
Strings.database.connection_hint: Local management connection verified independently of application accounts. Manage application credentials in Databases and accounts.
Strings.database.recovery_hint: Recovery resumes only a recorded safe checkpoint. An uncertain native operation remains blocked for inspection.
Strings.database.session_changed: Server session changed; reopen this application
Strings.database.confirm.Initialize: Initialize and start this PostgreSQL instance?
Strings.database.confirm.Stop: Stop this instance? Active database connections will be interrupted.
Strings.database.confirm.Verify: Verify the running instance using a local management connection?
Strings.database.confirm.Recover: Inspect and resume the recorded transaction where safe?
Strings.database.package_install_only: Installs the engine only; initialize an instance in Database engines.
Strings.database.package_system_dependencies: APT may update system dependencies listed in this plan.
Strings.database.native_failed: A native operation failed; inspect the pending transaction.
Strings.database.source_unsupported: No supported official Ubuntu source is configured.
Strings.database.instance_invalid: The instance identity or port does not match.
Strings.database.native_output_limit: Native output exceeded the supported limit.
Strings.database.artifact_changed: Downloaded package does not match the frozen digest.
Strings.database.external_installation: Existing PostgreSQL resources require manual review.
Strings.database.operation_conflict: This operation ID belongs to a different request.
Strings.database.package_identity_changed: Installed package identity or files changed.
Strings.database.operation_unverified: No matching committed operation receipt was found.
Strings.database.not_running: The PostgreSQL instance is not running.
Strings.database.package_unresolved: Cannot resolve a supported PostgreSQL package.
Strings.database.installation_exists: Installation already exists or is pending.
Strings.database.path_untrusted: A managed path contains an unexpected symbolic link.
Strings.database.plan_changed: The installation plan or instance revision changed; refresh first.
Strings.database.operation_unknown: No original operation record was found.
Strings.database.operation_unavailable: The native database operation is unavailable.
Strings.database.configuration_drift: Instance configuration changed outside this application.
Strings.database.stop_unconfirmed: Service stop has not been confirmed.
Strings.database.state_capacity: Database operation ledger reached its capacity.
Strings.application.relaxkonos.database.descript: Install and manage a local PostgreSQL instance
Strings.database.version_unsupported: This PostgreSQL package version is not supported.
Strings.database.inventory_unknown: Cannot establish the existing PostgreSQL inventory.
Strings.database.package_dependencies_unsupporte: The package dependency set is unsupported.
Strings.database.package_dependencies_incomplete: The frozen package dependency set is incomplete.
Strings.database.accounts_scope: Manage only resources created here. Read-only, read/write and migration permissions are separate.
Strings.database.name_rule: 1–40 lowercase letters, digits or underscores; start with a letter. Reserved names and pg_/rk_ prefixes are unavailable.
Strings.database.connection_local: Connection from the server itself: host:port / database / account. Remote access is not enabled.
Strings.database.applications_need_update: Database password verified. Update dependent applications separately; their credentials have not been changed.
Strings.database.permission_hint: Daily accounts cannot create databases, roles, schemas or tables. Migration accounts may SET ROLE to the owner; use that role when creating objects so default grants apply.
Strings.database.password_rule: Use 16–128 printable ASCII characters without spaces. Passwords stay hidden and are cleared when the request is prepared.
Strings.database.password_effect: New connections are checked after rotation. Existing sessions continue. Account-management recovery uses the existing local administrator; lost administrator recovery is not supported.
Strings.database.accounts_confirm: Confirm the following database operation. New databases restrict PUBLIC access, including connections to the default databases. Permission changes and password rotation affect new connections; update dependent applications separately.
Strings.database.account_request_pending: Request outcome is unknown. Retry the original request; no new password will be generated.
Strings.database.accounts_recovery_required: Account transaction needs reconciliation; the database may already have changed.
Strings.database.credential_invalid: Password or credential reference is invalid.
Strings.database.credential_conflict: This credential reference is bound to another value.
Strings.database.credential_unavailable: Protected credentials are unavailable. No password was exported.
Strings.database.credential_unchanged: Choose a password different from the current password.
Strings.database.resource_exists: The database or role already exists; it will not be adopted.
Strings.database.resource_unmanaged: This resource is not owned by this database manager.
Strings.database.resource_identity_changed: The native database or role identity changed.
Strings.database.grant_drift: Role capabilities or database isolation differ from the recorded grant.
Strings.database.account_verification_failed: The new account connection could not be verified.
Strings.database.old_password_not_rejected: Old-password rejection could not be confirmed.
Strings.database.credential_identity_changed: The native credential differs from the staged revision.
Strings.database.admin_recovery_hint: Disconnects all database sessions, restores the fixed postgres administrator role and removes its password; local peer authentication remains. Failures stay isolated. Success leaves the instance stopped: start it explicitly. Configuration or data identity drift is refused.
Strings.database.admin_recovery_confirm: Enter maintenance and recover administrator identity? All sessions will disconnect and the administrator password will be removed. The instance will remain stopped.
Strings.database.admin_recovery_pending: Administrator recovery is incomplete. Keep isolation and resume the original operation.
Strings.database.admin_recovery_authorization: Dedicated administrator recovery authorization is required.
Strings.database.remote_hint: Allows only specified sources, database and ordinary account. Host nftables is required. Close access before changing policy or certificate; renewed certificates are not deployed automatically.
Strings.database.remote_name: Server DNS name covered by the certificate
Strings.database.remote_sources: Allowed source CIDRs, comma separated; e.g. 192.168.10.0/24
Strings.database.remote_probe_hint: Server checks do not prove external reachability. Probe from allowed sources with a trusted CA and sslmode=verify-full; verify denied sources, non-TLS and wrong passwords fail. Verify closure externally.
Strings.database.remote_confirm: Change remote access? Disconnects all sessions. Enabling restarts PostgreSQL; closing leaves it stopped until explicitly started. Only owned firewall rules change.
Strings.database.remote_request_invalid: Check listener IP, canonical CIDRs, account and certificate; close existing access first.
Strings.database.tls_invalid: Certificate missing, invalid, or name/fingerprint mismatch.
Strings.database.firewall_unavailable: Host nftables is missing or unavailable.
Strings.database.remote_recovery_required: Remote configuration is incomplete; recover the original operation.
Strings.database.maintenance_hint: Maintenance stops the instance and closes connections; start it explicitly afterwards. Supports verified PostgreSQL 16 Ubuntu packages and migrated PostgreSQL 18 PGDG packages. Disable remote access first. Restore requires matching versions, accounts, grants and credential references.
Strings.database.maintenance_confirm: This stops the service and performs the selected maintenance. Deleting data permanently removes this instance’s data, backups and managed credentials. Other actions retain verified backups. Continue?
Strings.database.delete_confirmation: To delete, enter the instance ID from Overview without hyphens.
Strings.database.maintenance_plan_failed: Unable to verify the maintenance candidate. Check sources and state.
Strings.database.package_retained: Engine removed; instance record retained for reinstall.
Strings.database.maintenance_invalid: Maintenance request does not match the instance state.
Strings.database.maintenance_version_unsupported: The candidate patch has no reviewed maintenance path.
Strings.database.maintenance_pending: Maintenance is unfinished. Resume the original operation.
Strings.database.maintenance_authorization: This recovery requires database maintenance authority.
Strings.database.maintenance_package_uncertain: Package outcome is uncertain. The instance stays isolated until native package state is repaired and verified.
Strings.database.maintenance_migration_required: The reviewed patch correction script is missing; maintenance remains pending.
Strings.database.backup_capacity: The initial limit of eight backups has been reached. New maintenance backups are blocked.
Strings.database.backup_changed: Backup files or manifest changed. Restore is refused.
Strings.database.backup_identity_changed: Backup version, configuration, accounts or credential references differ from the instance. Restore is refused.
Strings.database.backup_scope_unsupported: This maintenance slice does not support unmanaged databases, extensions, replication or external tablespaces.
Strings.database.backup_space_insufficient: Insufficient free space for backup and restore verification.
Strings.database.backup_unverified: Backup has not passed isolated restore verification.
Strings.database.restore_uncertain: Data directory switch is uncertain. Original operation and isolation are retained.
Strings.database.backup_schedule_hint: Local offline recovery points only. Enabling makes the first run due immediately, then repeats at the configured interval. Running instances are skipped by default. If downtime is allowed, connections close and the prior running state is restored after success. Retention removes old automatic backups only after a new verified backup; manual and pre-update backups remain.
Strings.database.backup_schedule_downtime: Allow scheduled downtime and restore prior running state on success
Strings.database.backup_schedule_stopped_only: Back up only while already stopped
Strings.database.backup_schedule_confirm: This ongoing authorization remains effective after closing the client or signing out, until disabled. Allowing downtime interrupts application connections. Retention deletes only excess verified automatic backups. Failure may leave the instance stopped pending recovery. Save this policy?
Strings.database.backup_schedule_verified: Automatic backup and restore verification completed
Strings.database.backup_schedule_running: Skipped: instance is running and downtime was not authorized
Strings.database.backup_schedule_lifecycle: Instance lifecycle changed. Review and enable the policy again
Strings.database.backup_schedule_changed: Policy or due slot changed; stale request refused
Strings.database.backup_schedule_invalid: Use an interval of 1–168 hours and retention of 1–6
Strings.database.backup_delete_confirm: Permanently delete the selected backup and its restore reference, keeping current instance data. It may be the only recovery point. Continue?
Strings.database.migration_source: I confirm the official PostgreSQL PGDG noble-pgdg source and the key below
Strings.database.migration_hint: Managed 16.15 → 18.7 only. Migration stops service, updates shared client/common/libpq5 packages and retains a verified old-version backup. It finishes stopped and disables scheduled backups. No automatic downgrade. Verify application compatibility first.
Strings.database.migration_confirm: Migrate {0}? Signed packages from https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt will be used for offline backup, copy migration and privilege checks. Failure remains isolated; unknown native outcomes are not blindly retried.
Strings.database.migration_invalid: Migration scope or prerequisites are not satisfied.
Strings.database.migration_version_unsupported: The candidate is outside the verified major migration range.
Strings.database.migration_uncertain: Native migration outcome is uncertain; isolation and the original operation remain pending evidence.
Strings.database.migration_ca_required: Install trusted system CA certificates before verifying the PGDG HTTPS source.
